amendments.body: In engine.rs lines 410-411, `substrate_oxygenation_breakdown()` is called once for tracing metrics, then `step_substrate_zones()` calls it again internally. Each invocation recomputes the full habitat registry via `compute_habitat_registry()`. Refactor `step_substrate_zones` to accept a pre-computed `SubstrateOxygenationBreakdown` (or return one alongside applying it) to avoid the redundant computation.
amendments.rationale: The habitat registry computation involves iterating all habitats, computing areas, and exposure modifiers. Doing it twice per tick is pure waste. While not a correctness bug, in a simulation that runs hundreds of thousands of ticks this adds up. The fix is straightforward: add a `step_substrate_zones_with_breakdown(state, breakdown)` variant or have `step_substrate_zones` return the breakdown.

amendments.body: The removal of root respiration O₂ demand from `estimate_substrate_o2_demand_rate()` (previously ~10% of rooted biomass × BOD rate) means the model now only accounts for the O₂ *supply* side of root activity (ROL) without the corresponding O₂ *consumption* (root metabolism). Add a brief code comment in `estimate_substrate_o2_demand_rate` documenting this as a deliberate simplification and noting that net ROL already accounts for this in the literature-calibrated `rol_rate_cm_per_g` default.
amendments.rationale: The old code had root respiration contributing to O₂ demand (root_demand = rooted_biomass_g × bod_rate × 0.1). The new code removes this entirely while adding the ROL bonus. If the 0.15 cm/g default is calibrated to net ROL (supply minus consumption), this is correct. But without a comment explaining this, a future maintainer might re-add root respiration demand, double-counting the consumption. A single-line comment prevents this.

amendments.body: The `substrate_root_activity_factor` computation at substrate.rs:348 uses `(surface_area_cm2 - footprint_area_cm2).max(0.0)` to isolate interstitial area. This is correct when SubstrateSurface = footprint + interstitial, but if the habitat registry formula ever changes, this subtraction will silently produce wrong results. Add an inline comment explaining the physical meaning: 'SubstrateSurface area includes footprint top surface; subtract it to get only interstitial grain-matrix area available for root colonization.'
amendments.rationale: The correctness of this subtraction depends on an implementation detail of `compute_substrate_surface()` in habitat.rs. If that formula changes (e.g., adding roughness multipliers to the footprint component), this subtraction breaks without any compile-time or test-time signal. A clarifying comment anchors the invariant.

payload.summary: The root-zone oxygenation implementation is solid. All tests pass (25 substrate unit tests, 5 integration tests, 1 habitat registry test). The exponential saturation model `depth × (1 - exp(-(biomass × rate) / depth))` correctly preserves linear low-biomass behavior while saturating at substrate depth. Guild filtering correctly restricts ROL to RootFeedingRosette only. The habitat-aware active biomass calculation properly accounts for substrate access, habitat index, and uptake bias. Named parameters are used throughout, and tracing/budget metrics expose all components of the breakdown. Three minor issues found: (1) double computation of the breakdown in the engine hot path, (2) removed root respiration demand needs a comment explaining that the ROL rate already accounts for net effect, (3) fragile coupling between `substrate_root_activity_factor` and the habitat registry's SubstrateSurface area formula.
